## Research focus

My research develops and evaluates statistical and machine-learning methods for complex biomedical prediction problems. I am particularly interested in the reliability of models trained with many features and limited samples.

- Reliable and explainable artificial intelligence for biomedical prediction
- Statistical reliability of high-dimensional and small-sample models
- RNA-sequencing and DNA-methylation analysis
- Feature-selection stability and explanation reproducibility
- Model calibration, uncertainty estimation, and external validation
- Human-supervised AI for healthcare decision support

## Statistical Reliability of High-Dimensional Breast Cancer RNA-Sequencing Models

This independent project evaluates estrogen-receptor status prediction using GSE81538 for model development and GSE96058 for independent external validation.

The analysis includes 18,213 aligned genes, repeated stratified validation, development-sample-size stress testing, feature-selection stability, coefficient-direction reproducibility, bootstrap confidence intervals, and Brier-score assessment.

The fitted models achieved strong external discrimination while the sample-size experiments demonstrated severe instability at small development sizes. The project includes analysis notebooks, compact results, model documentation, integrity checks, and a reproducible software release.

[View repository](https://github.com/Enock-ackaah/statistical-reliability-high-dimensional-er-models) · [Software release](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21524693)

## Cancer Classification in Low- and High-Dimensional Biomedical Data

This study compares logistic regression, support vector machines, random forests, and K-nearest neighbors using low-dimensional breast-tissue measurements and high-dimensional osteosarcoma DNA-methylation data.

The low-dimensional models produced comparatively stable results. The high-dimensional analysis demonstrated the reliability problems that arise when the number of molecular features is extremely large relative to the available sample size.

[View repository](https://github.com/Enock-ackaah/cancer-classification-low-high-dimensional-data) · [Read the preprint](https://doi.org/10.20944/preprints202608.0073.v1)

## DNA-Methylation-Based Tumor-Normal Classification

An interpretable colorectal tumor-versus-normal classification workflow using LASSO and Elastic Net logistic regression with high-dimensional DNA-methylation data.

[View repository](https://github.com/Enock-ackaah/DNA-Methylation-Based-Tumor-Normal-Classification) · [Software release](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21819138)

## Transcriptomic Comparison of CHP and IPF

A reproducible RNA-sequencing and DESeq2 analysis comparing chronic hypersensitivity pneumonitis and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis using GSE150910.

[View repository](https://github.com/Enock-ackaah/Transcriptomic-Comparison-of-Chronic-Hypersensitivity-Pneumonitis-and-Idiopathic-Pulmonary-Fibrosis-)
